text:
Riya: Tiny question — what's one super small skill you think everyone should know but rarely do? :thinking:
Ben: How to fold a fitted sheet. Life-changing. :tshirt:
Maya: Basic first-aid: how to stop a bleed and apply a bandage. Simple but critical. :white_small_square:
Owen: Tell time on an analogue clock. Shocking how many can't? :alarm_clock:
Riya: @Maya agreed. My partner taught me how to remove splinters cleanly — underused knowledge.
Theo: Making a decent omelette. Breakfast sovereignty. :egg:
Zoe: Password hygiene: how to use a password manager + 2FA. Boring but saves careers. :lock:
Ben: Also, changing a tyre. Roadside freedom. :car:
Maya: ops-bot: poll? Which one do we want as a micro-workshop this Friday? (react with 1 for folding, 2 for first-aid, 3 analogue clock, 4 omelette, 5 password hygiene, 6 change a tyre)
ops-bot: Poll created in #random-polls. React with the corresponding emoji to vote. Poll open for 20 minutes.
Riya: Voting for first-aid and omelette. If forced to pick one: first-aid.
Owen: Folding sheet is my secret superpower. Will trade for omelette lesson. :handshake:
Zoe: If password hygiene wins, I'll do a 15-min demo.
Ben: If tyre-changing wins, I will actually bring a jack and a wheel wrench. :muscle:
Theo: Promise there will be eggs. :egg::heart:
Riya: Results: looks like first-aid edges it out. Workshop scheduled Fri 12:30 in Kitchenette. Bring questions + appetite. :calendar::white_check_mark:
Maya: Yay. I will bring bandage supplies and an extra splinter kit. :medical_symbol:
Owen: I still demand a second session on fitted sheets. :joy:
Riya: Noted. Two workshops now. Maybe a micro-credentials badge? :medal:
Zoe: Badge for most improved household skills. Love it.
